name: @frank/adaptor-signatures
description: Research prototype: ECDSA adaptor signatures ("scriptless scripts") over secp256k1. Standalone crypto primitive, not wired into any wallet/message code -- see README-less commit message / PR description for context (ticket: research/ecdsa-adaptor-sigs branch). Implements the DLEQ-based ECDSA adaptor signature construction from the discreetlogcontracts/dlcspecs ECDSA-adaptor.md spec (Fournier + Aumayr et al.), plus an added Schnorr proof-of-knowledge of the tweak secret so the construction is sound outside the DLC-only context that spec restricts itself to.
